name: std::ranges::subrange<I,S,K>::next

declarations.code:
constexpr subrange next(std::iter_difference_t<I> n = 1) const &

    requires std::forward_iterator<I>;

sections.title: Parameter
sections.text:
n

 -

 number of maximal increments of the iterator

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The difference between this function and advance() is that the latter performs the increment (or decrement) in place.

summary: Returns a subrange whose begin_ is incremented (or decremented if n is negative). The actual increment (or decrement) operation is performed by advance().
